source: SAIS mailing lists (sais.ti@lists.jh.edu, CampusGroups), messages of 2026-09-14 to 2026-09-21

events.title: A Conversation with a Defense Policy Advisor
events.location: Hopkins Bloomberg Center, 555 Pennsylvania Ave NW
events.description: Focus-area conversation with a defense policy advisor on career paths and current defense policy debates.
events.why: General defense-policy careers talk with no stated technology angle, so only marginally on ETI's beat.

events.title: Following the Money On-Chain: Crypto Tracing for Illicit Finance
events.location: Room 422, Hopkins Bloomberg Center, 555 Pennsylvania Ave NW
events.host: SAIS T&I focus area, Defense and Intelligence Club, and TRM Labs
events.description: Hands-on TRM Labs workshop on reading a blockchain as an analyst: transaction models, address-clustering heuristics on a real Bitcoin transaction, and money-laundering typologies. Free browser-based tools; no prerequisites. Lunch from 12:15.
events.why: Rare hands-on tradecraft session at SAIS on tracing crypto used for sanctions evasion and illicit finance; RSVP required and seating is limited.

events.title: TRM Labs User Conference + Blockchain Capture the Flag
events.host: TRM Labs; SAIS delegation via the Defense and Intelligence Club with the T&I and SSS focus areas
events.description: Two-day TRM Labs user conference and hands-on blockchain capture-the-flag competition bringing together government and private-sector practitioners in blockchain intelligence, illicit finance and cyber. SAIS sends a selected student team.
events.why: Strong practitioner exposure to blockchain intelligence and illicit finance, but SAIS attendance is by application only and the Sept. 28 workshop is a prerequisite.
